MR.App.Title: The table · Follow
MR.Tab.Label: Sections
MR.Step.Label: Story progress
MR.Action.UndoHint: Undo the last game step (host only)
MR.Lobby.Title: A new fellowship
MR.Lobby.Subtitle: Choose a quest, take your seats and begin. There is nothing to prepare.
MR.Lobby.ChooseQuestHelp: The quest sets the shared goal and offers ideas for characters and challenges. Add your own in the Quests tab.
MR.Lobby.NoQuests: No quests yet. Create one in the Quests tab.
MR.Lobby.SeatsHelp: Order follows the table clockwise: the next person is the one on your left.
MR.Lobby.GuestPlaceholder: Name of someone without an account
MR.Lobby.TooMany: The game is meant for 3–5 people; you cannot start with more than 6.
MR.Lobby.Advisory: The game works best with 3–5 people.
MR.Lobby.ReplaceBody: Starting another story will replace the current one. Continue?
MR.Quest.EditorHelp: One entry per line. Quests are stored in this world only.
MR.Quest.LibraryHelp: Sample quests ship with the system. If you own the Follow book, you can enter its quests here to use them in your world; the genre decides which tables the dice use.
MR.Quest.ChallengesHelp: Format: “Title — short description”. At least six are recommended.
MR.Quest.FewChallenges: Saved, but with fewer than three challenges the game will run short.
MR.Setup.Title: Set up the quest
MR.Setup.GoalHelp: Rewrite it in your own words if you like. It is what everyone is working towards.
MR.Setup.DifficultiesHelp: What makes this quest hard? Pick two from the list or write your own.
MR.Characters.Title: The fellowship
MR.Characters.Help: Everyone completes their sheet: a main character and a minor one. Your main character wants something from the one on your left, who refuses.
MR.Character.Name: Name
MR.Character.DesireHelp: What your character personally gains if the quest succeeds.
MR.Character.WantHelp: Something important that character denies you. Decide together why.
MR.Character.SheetHelp: The game is played at the table. This sheet is for tokens or personal notes.
MR.Company.Title: The fellowship
MR.Company.RingCaption: Each arrow points to whoever has something you need.
MR.Challenge.Untitled: What stands in the way now?
MR.Challenge.Name: Challenge
MR.Challenge.WhyHelp: Describe the obstacle, not how to overcome it.
MR.Challenge.Timescale: How much time do the scenes span?
MR.Scene.ConsequencePlaceholder: If something comes too easily, add its price here…
MR.Scene.EndLast: End and go to the stones
MR.Scene.Guide1: Whoever sets up the scene says who is there, where, and what is happening. Then everyone plays their character.
MR.Scene.Guide2: Nobody decides in a scene whether the challenge succeeds: the stones will tell.
MR.Scene.Guide3: If someone gets something too easily, anyone may propose a consequence. Your character is yours: others negotiate with you what happens to them.
MR.Scene.Guide4: Two or three characters per scene work best. When in doubt, cut early.
MR.Stones.Help: Everyone adds their stones in secret. Nobody knows what the others put in.
MR.Stones.DiscontentQ: How does your character feel about where the fellowship is heading?
MR.Stones.VerdictQ: And you, as a player: did the fellowship do what was needed?
MR.Stones.Waiting: Waiting for everyone else to add their stones…
MR.Stones.ActForAll: Add stones on behalf of other seats (only if they can't)
MR.Stones.Carried: This bowl already holds one white per success ({successes}) and one red per failure ({failures}).
MR.Outcome.white-white.Title: You succeed
MR.Outcome.white-white.Text: The challenge is overcome and the fellowship holds together.
MR.Outcome.red-white.Title: You succeed, but lose someone
MR.Outcome.red-white.Text: The challenge is overcome at a price: one character leaves the fellowship.
MR.Outcome.white-red.Title: You fail and lose someone
MR.Outcome.white-red.Text: The challenge is not overcome and one character leaves the fellowship. The quest goes on.
MR.Outcome.red-red.Title: Failure and betrayal
MR.Outcome.red-red.Text: The challenge is not overcome and someone turns against the fellowship or abandons it.
MR.Loss.Title: Who do you lose?
MR.Loss.Help: Decide together which character leaves the story. Their player has the final say on how it happens.
MR.Loss.HelpBetrayal: A betrayal is the character's conscious choice, not an accident. Decide together who; their player tells how.
MR.Loss.Incomplete: Choose a character and how they leave the story.
MR.Fate.leftHint: Walks away from the fellowship by choice.
MR.Fate.expelledHint: The fellowship turns its back on them.
MR.Replace.Title: {seat} has no main character
MR.Replace.Help: Adopt someone else's minor character or introduce someone new. New main characters have no want towards their left.
MR.Epilogue.Help: Each person tells what became of their main character afterwards. Was it worth the price?
MR.Epilogue.NoMain: Tell the epilogue of their last main character, or introduce someone who remembers the story.
MR.Epilogue.FinishConfirm: The story will be archived and the credits shown. Close it?
MR.Credits.Thanks: Thank you for telling this story together.
MR.Credits.PopupBlocked: The browser blocked the print window.
MR.Chronicle.Help: Everything that has happened in the story, newest first.
MR.Safety.Title: Table comfort
MR.Safety.Help: Anyone can ask for a pause or a change without explaining why. Signals never say who sent them.
MR.Safety.Privacy: Nobody's use of these tools is recorded.
MR.Safety.LinesHelp: Content that will not appear in the story.
MR.Safety.VeilsHelp: Content that may happen, but off-screen.
MR.Safety.PausedBody: Someone asked to stop. Take a breath, talk if you need to, and continue when the group is ready.
MR.Safety.PausedWait: The host will resume the game.
MR.Safety.Signal.rewind: Someone asked to rewind the last scene.
MR.Safety.Signal.fade: Someone asked for a fade to black.
MR.Archive.Help: Each game is a fellowship in the Actors directory. The active one opens on login.
MR.Settings.AutoOpenHint: When the world loads, opens the active fellowship sheet (and your sheet while characters are being created).
MR.Settings.ReducedMotionHint: Turns off the stone animation and transitions.
MR.Error.NoHost: No host (GM) is connected: the table cannot save changes.
MR.Error.NoHostSafety: No host is connected. Say it aloud or in chat.
MR.Error.HostOnly: Only the host can do this.
MR.Error.NoStory: There is no story in progress.
MR.Error.FewSeats: At least two people are needed.
MR.Error.WrongPhase: That can't be done at this point in the game.
MR.Error.NoWant: Only original main characters have a want towards their left.
MR.Error.LeadMustBeMain: A main character must lead the challenge.
MR.Error.NeedMain: Every main character needs a name and a concept.
MR.Error.NotAllReady: Some people haven't finished their characters.
MR.Error.AlreadyPicked: That person already chose a challenge.
MR.Error.NeedPicker: First decide who chooses the challenge.
MR.Error.PickerDecides: The person choosing the challenge decides this.
MR.Error.EstablisherDecides: The person setting up the scene describes this.
MR.Error.StonesPending: Some people still need to add their stones.
MR.Error.LossDone: The loss has already been decided.
MR.Error.BadFate: Choose how the character leaves the story.
MR.Error.LossPending: Before moving on, decide who you lose.
MR.Error.SeatHasMain: That seat already has a main character.
MR.Error.Unexpected: Something went wrong. Check the console (F12).
MR.Fellowship.Empty: This fellowship has no game yet. Start one from the lobby.
MR.Turn.Characters: Your turn: complete your sheet and mark “I'm ready”.
MR.Turn.AllReady: Everyone is ready: on to the first challenge!
MR.Turn.YourScene: Your turn to set up scene {n}.
MR.Turn.Stones: Your turn: add your stones in secret.
MR.Turn.Draw: All stones are in the bowl: draw two.
MR.Turn.Epilogue: Your turn: write your main character's epilogue.
MR.Lobby.StartHelp: This creates the fellowship sheet and two sheets per seat, each owned by its player, in an Actors folder.
MR.Character.ReadyHelp: Once your main character has a name and a concept, let the group know.
MR.Character.Epilogue: Epilogue: what became of your main character?
MR.Character.WantGeneric: What you need from the main character on your left
MR.Character.Free: This character doesn't belong to any fellowship yet.
MR.Roll.Name: Random name
MR.Roll.All: Fill in the blanks at random
MR.Roll.AllHint: Fills empty fields. With Shift, it changes everything.
MR.Chat.Speaker: The fellowship
MR.Settings.ChatCardsHint: Posts challenges, scenes, stones and losses to chat.
